data.one_liner: Automatically generates asset entries in pubspec.yaml by scanning subdirectories.
data.what_it_does: It scans all subdirectories inside the assets folder and automatically adds them to pubspec.yaml. Running the tool updates existing asset entries instead of appending duplicates.
use_when: You have a large number of nested asset directories and want to automate updating pubspec.yaml
You want to avoid manually maintaining asset paths in pubspec.yaml
avoid_when: You only have a few static asset files and prefer manual configuration
strengths: Updates assets instead of appending them on repeated runs
Supports multiple platforms including android, ios, windows, macos, and linux
Fixes path handling issues like Windows backslashes
weaknesses: Limited documentation and setup details in the README
data.setup_notes: Place your files and folders in the assets directory and execute flutter pub run asset_fill.
